prs.caveat: XADD has no MAXLEN/MINID trim, so the atlas:events:v1 stream is unbounded. Live Valkey runs maxmemory-policy noeviction (2 GiB), so an unbounded stream would eventually reject writes. Add an approximate MAXLEN (or MINID by age) before any producer is wired. Not changed here because it alters the PR contract and nothing publishes yet.
